scope: Remove duplicate React keys when opening a task detail from quick search.
finding: TaskSchedulePanel and TaskComments were siblings keyed only by the same task ID. The historical task search integration reproduced React duplicate-key warnings.
change: Give each sibling component a distinct key prefix while retaining the task ID, so each panel resets when the selected task changes.
Extend the historical search integration test to fail if React reports duplicate child keys.
